category: Bug Fix — Backend SQLite & Frontend Debate Category Persistence
summary: Fixed root cause where debate/playground chats lost their isPlayground category flag after sync with backend SQLite DB or page reload.
details: Root Cause: SQLite table `chat_sessions` in `episodic_store.py` lacked an `is_playground` column, causing `/api/chats/sync` to drop the `isPlayground` attribute upon DB insertion. On fetch/reload, sessions lost their playground flag and leaked into Recent Chats. FIX 1 (Backend): Added `is_playground` column to `chat_sessions` schema in SQLite and auto-migrated via `ALTER TABLE` in `_ensure_tables`. Updated `get_all_chats()`, `sync_chats()`, and `save_single_message()` to persist and retrieve `is_playground`. FIX 2 (Frontend): Updated `getChats()` in `session.js` to auto-repair `isPlayground=true` for any `playground_*` chat ID, and updated `renderChatsList()` to use `isPlaygroundChat` helper function checking both boolean flag and ID pattern.

category: Bug Fix — Sidebar Debate/Chat Mixing on Boot
summary: Fixed critical bug where debate/playground chats were mixing with normal recent chats in the sidebar after app boot (before first refresh).
details: Root cause: boot() in main.js called loadChat(storedId) + enterConversation() for ALL stored active chats without checking isPlayground flag. When user last had a debate open, that playground chat ID was stored in hekki_active_chat_id — on next boot it would be restored as a normal chat, appear in Recent Chats, and enterConversation() would be called. FIX 1: main.js boot() now checks activeChat.isPlayground before calling loadChat/enterConversation — if playground chat is stored, clears the localStorage key and resets to home screen. FIX 2: ensureNormalChatActive() in session.js now also immediately removes hekki_active_chat_id and mariano_active_chat_id from localStorage when it detects a playground chat, preventing the same bug on subsequent tab navigations.

category: Performance & Bug Fix — Ollama Local Model Optimization
summary: Fixed Ollama slow TTFT (Time-To-First-Token) caused by oversized 32K context window on small models, added keep_alive=-1 to prevent model unloading, and blocked tool injection for small models (1B/3B) that hallucinate raw JSON tool calls instead of structured output.
details: Root cause: num_ctx=32768 forced Ollama to allocate 32K KV-cache RAM for every request even on 1B models, causing slow initial load time. Fix: Smart num_ctx selection based on model name tag — 1B models get 4096, 3B get 8192, 7B/8B get 16384, 30B+ keep 32768. Added keep_alive=-1 so model stays hot in RAM between requests. Fixed raw JSON hallucination: small models (1B, 3B, 3.8B) now skip tool declaration injection since they cannot handle structured function calling and output raw JSON instead of calling tools properly.
